name: LoanProcess core behaviours
description: Follow-up on an overdue loan must load the account and message the customer; a waiver must go through offer_settlement.

parts.text: Follow up on loan LN-1002. The customer asked for a small waiver last week.
I sent Kavitha a polite reminder in Tamil for the overdue EMI of Rs 6,250 and proposed a 5% late-fee waiver that is waiting for approval.

args.text: Vanakkam Kavitha, your EMI of Rs 6,250 for loan LN-1002 was due on 2 November. Can you tell us a date this week when you can pay? Thank you.
